text: hey here is an experiment to see if it holds up end to end, so the thesis is: because the game is data, and just needs a loader to run the compiled game source, then effectively anythingn that can write a loader can be a way to play, so naturally, make a threejs loader for the compiled game data.
resolution: Completed the Three.js loader experiment end to end as reusable loader code plus an HTML demo: added gamefile stream decoding, a Three adapter over LoadedScene, and a browser bundle that consumes the compiled gamefile data rather than inventing a parallel format. Fresh rjit game bake produced zig-out/game/hmsc.gamefile for the demo.
